Every phase read captures already on disk: the reader repairs were verified against persisted policy blocks, and the store, closure, packet, review, benchmark and duplicate scan are all projections of those same bytes.

shared_modules_changed_names: scripts/pettripfinder/brightdata/policy_reading.py (eleven reading repairs, each verified against a persisted Louisville block and each carrying its own negative control)
scripts/pettripfinder/policy/policy_observation.py (contract 1.3.0: seven flag codes the readers emit)
scripts/pettripfinder/founder_review_analysis.py (a review may not demand a field the record explicitly withheld)
architecture.note: Zero Louisville-specific scripts. Every repair is in a module every market reads, and every one was found by asking a persisted block what it says.

items: A FEE and a DEPOSIT that are the same number are two charges. The labelled-amount pass skipped any amount already explained, so 'Pet fee per night: 40 USD Pet damage deposit: 40 USD' published one charge and dropped the other.

'No dogs allowed' contained 'dogs allowed' and was read as an affirmation, so a page refusing dogs listed dog among the species it accepts. Fixed with the same negation guard the new qualified form uses.

Seven flag codes the readers emit were not in the closed FLAG_CODES vocabulary, so the membrane refused whole observations over the NAME of a note attached to them. Reconciled by listing every code the readers emit, not by adding the one that was found.

A review that demands a field the record explicitly withheld turns every honest refusal into a correction. Louisville states a weight with no unit, a weight for two animals together and a weight no pet has; all three are right to be absent.

production_safety.note: PTF-LOUISVILLE-FOUNDER-REMEDIATION-005 forbids all of the above. No founder signature was written: founder_decision, founder_reviewer_id and founder_reviewed_at are empty on all 63 packet rows. The two founder rulings folded in are recorded as decisions with their evidence and their scope, and neither is an attestation over a row.
